725:t_026:0.en:
$$ズール$$
「Why?! Why can I not defeat them?!」

725:t_026:1.en:
$$ズール$$
「My name is Emperor $$ズール$$! I am the one who will rule all universes in place of the $$御使い$$s!」

725:t_026:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「It's over, $$ズール$$! Now you'll pay for taking innocent lives!」

725:t_026:3.en:
$$ズール$$
「Silence, $$マーズ$$! If $$イデア$$ had not sent the six god robots to Earth back then, this would never...!」

725:t_026:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「My father's love on $$ギシン星$$ saved me! My Earth parents' love raised me, $$マーグ$$'s love guided me, and $$ロゼ$$'s love makes me strong!」

725:t_026:5.en:
$$ズール$$
「Love?! I, $$ズール$$, am losing to something like love?!」

725:t_026:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「That's right! You don't understand what love means. You have no place in this universe!」

725:t_026:7.en:
$$タケル$$
「Vanish into darkness, $$ズール$$! I won't let you have this world's light!」

725:t_027:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「Yes... $$ズール$$'s soul fell completely into darkness. He will never return to this world now.」

725:t_027:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「If this world is swallowed by darkness... by the force that seeks to vanish, $$ズール$$ might regain his power.」

725:t_027:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「That is another reason we must protect this universe and fill it with light.」

725:t_027:6.en:
$$タケル$$
(So, Brother. I'll keep fighting until the day we restore peace...)

725:t_027:7.en:
$$タケル$$
(Together with your soul and this $$ゴッドマーズ$$.)

725:t_100:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「We'll settle this today, $$ハーデス$$!」

725:t_100:1.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「You dare speak as an equal to me, the king of the underworld, mere human?!」

725:t_100:2.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Accept it, $$ハーデス$$! They have raised themselves to walk alongside us. They are our new brethren!」

725:t_100:3.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Silence, $$ゼウス$$! That is only because you lent them your power!」

725:t_100:4.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「That is not so! They stand here now because they overcame the light and darkness within them by their own strength!」

725:t_100:5.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「I refuse...! I will never accept that!」

725:t_100:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then, $$ハーデス$$! Experience it firsthand...」

725:t_100:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「Our anger, our fighting spirit... and our hope for the future! We will win!!」

725:t_101:1.en:
$$ズール$$
「$$マーズ$$! Even if you have become one with $$マーグ$$, you cannot defeat me!」

725:t_101:2.en:
$$ズール$$
「I am the very darkness of the universe! I am Emperor $$ズール$$, ruler of darkness!」

725:t_101:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「Now I can understand even your darkness.」

725:t_101:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「Fear, anxiety, despair... Everyone feels them! But you lost to them, fell into them, and let them consume you!」

725:t_101:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「I cannot give someone like you the future... or the love that fills this universe!」

725:t_101:7.en:
$$ズール$$
「Keep babbling, $$マーズ$$! Then my darkness shall devour your light and absorb its power!」

725:t_101:8.en:
$$タケル$$
「It's useless, $$ズール$$! We'll unite light and darkness and advance into a new world!!」

725:t_102:0.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Curse you, $$金田正太郎$$! Then I, the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, shall personally bury $$鉄人$$, your hope!」

725:t_102:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Those words won't scare me! However much darkness you gather, neither we nor $$鉄人$$ will be swallowed by it!」

725:t_102:2.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Such a strong will...! Is that what gives $$鉄人$$ power?!」

725:t_102:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Prepare yourself, $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$! You were swallowed by despair and became one with darkness. The Messenger of the Sun will defeat you!」

725:t_102:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do it, $$鉄人$$! This time we'll destroy the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ completely!!」

725:t_103:0.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Come, $$グーラ$$! I shall teach you the universe's truth once more!」

725:t_103:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
「The universe's truth is not power, Father! It is life living together!」

725:t_103:2.en:
$$グーラ$$
「You must have known that once, Father! I will defeat you so that you remember it!!」

725:t_104:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「You bastards shouldn't act like you're gods! The great $$勝平$$ and $$ザンボット３$$ will wipe you out!」

725:t_104:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「We'll pay you back for all the times you mocked us! This is where you meet your end!!」

725:t_105:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「The sun is with me! It will never lose to any darkness!」

725:t_105:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「Prepare yourselves, apostles of darkness! $$ダイターン３$$'s light will shatter your darkness completely!」

725:t_106:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You've done evil all over the place, and now it's time to pay for it!」

725:t_106:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Get ready! Your threats about darkness and despair won't work anymore!」

725:t_107:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$鉄人$$ is the Messenger of the Sun! Its light won't lose to your darkness!」

725:t_107:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I'm not afraid of darkness! $$鉄人$$'s light and mine will break through it for sure!!」

725:t_108:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「However much darkness you bring against us, we won't fall into it!」

725:t_108:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「We're human! We'll overcome the wounds and regrets of the past and move toward the future!!」

725:t_109:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Too bad, you bastards! Even your last resort, those threats, won't work on us!」

725:t_109:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We've come this far, so cut out the cheap tricks! Come at us with everything you've got!!」

725:t_110:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「We're human! We're humans who live with light and darkness united!」

725:t_110:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「We won't lose to bastards like you who fell into darkness! Learn the strength of that!!」

725:t_111:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「I didn't come all this way to hear crap about darkness and despair!」

725:t_111:1.en:
$$カミナ$$
「That's right! You tell 'em, $$シモン$$!!」

725:t_111:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「Get ready! I'll drill a hole straight through your darkness!」

725:t_111:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「My drill pierces everything! Darkness, fear, despair... all of it!!」

725:t_112:0.en:
$$カズミ$$
「There is light in even the darkest darkness...!」

725:t_112:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Those lights of courage gather into a fire of hope, then into flames that burn our enemies to ash!」

725:t_112:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Our flames... $$ガンバスター$$'s flames won't lose to any darkness! We'll show you that!!」

725:t_113:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I'm not afraid of your bluffs anymore! We overcame despair to get here!」

725:t_113:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Let's go! Hope is showing us the way forward!」

725:t_114:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ and $c are indomitable warriors who won't flinch even at the threats of evil's ringleaders!」

725:t_114:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$ノノ$$ and $c are indomitable warriors who won't flinch even at the threats of evil's ringleaders!」

725:t_114:2.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「$$ノノ$$ and $c are indomitable warriors who won't flinch even at the threats of evil's ringleaders!」

725:t_114:4.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Your ambitions end here! Because...!」

725:t_114:5.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Your ambitions end here! Because...!」

725:t_114:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ and her friends are here!!」

725:t_114:7.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$ノノ$$ and her friends are here!!」

725:t_114:8.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「$$ノノ$$ and her friends are here!!」

725:t_115:0.en:
$$葵$$
「For self-proclaimed gods, you sure pull some petty crap!」

725:t_115:1.en:
$$葵$$
「If you're out of tricks, come at us with brute force! I'll crush you, pride and all!!」

725:t_116:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「You'll pay for what you've done to Earth and the other planets!」

725:t_116:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's do it! Even salarymen can defeat gods if they're villains!」

725:t_117:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Arrogant dictators who call yourselves gods. Your time of reckoning has come.」
